title: Rory and the Starry Clover Hill
verses:
The sun tumbled down as the shadows grew deep,
The hills of the valley were ready to sleep.
While Rory walked softly across the cool ground,
Without any rumble, without any sound.

Nia soared down through the evening's soft glow,
To watch the green valley and river below.
Tilly reached down where the clover grew sweet,
And gathered fresh petals around her four feet.

Benny stepped in with a slumberous hum,
To rest where the breezes of twilight had come.
Ricky stopped sprinting and slowed to a crawl,
Relaxing his paws by the leafy stone wall.

Psittaco nestled deep into the fern,
Watching the lanterns of silver stars burn.
Yawning so widely, he closed both his eyes,
Beneath the wide roof of the violet skies.

Rory lay down in the velvet green bed,
And rested a pillow of moss for his head.
Feeling the peace of the friends he held dear,
With nothing to worry and nothing to fear.

Stars sparkled softly in ribbons of blue,
As sleepy ferns drank up the silvery dew.
Breathing together till morning took flight,
All of the dinosaurs whispered goodnight.
